title: Medical students are using popular research tool to pump out misleading studies
summary: This Science.org article reports that medical students are increasingly using AI-powered research tools to rapidly generate studies, resulting in misleading or low-quality publications that threaten academic integrity and scientific rigor.
problem_solved: Exposes the misuse of AI research tools by medical students to generate misleading studies at scale.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical emerging threat to scientific literature quality and academic integrity that requires immediate attention from institutions, publishers, and educators.
